title: A 3D scene import disabled mesh LOD generation
suggestion: Turn meshes/generate_lods back on. resource_importer_scene.cpp defaults that option to true. The mesh LOD page explains what those generated levels are for.
tradeoff: Distant meshes stay at full triangle count.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A 3D scene import disabled shadow meshes
suggestion: Turn meshes/create_shadow_meshes back on unless the mesh never casts a shadow. resource_importer_scene.cpp defaults that option to true.
tradeoff: Shadow passes use the full mesh instead of the shadow mesh.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A 3D scene import disables mesh compression
suggestion: Turn meshes/force_disable_compression off. resource_importer_scene.cpp defaults it to false.
tradeoff: Compressed meshes can show a tiny difference in vertex positions.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A WAV import uses PCM instead of a compressed mode
suggestion: Set the WAV compress/mode away from 0 (PCM). resource_importer_wav.cpp lists 0 as PCM uncompressed and defaults to Quite OK Audio.
tradeoff: Compressed WAV modes lose a bit of fidelity.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A layered texture import (cubemap, array or 3D texture) uses lossless compression
suggestion: Use VRAM compression for cubemaps, texture arrays and 3D textures, which are only sampled in 3D. compress/mode 0 is lossless. Plain 2D textures are not counted here: lossless is the recommended 2D default, and textures.lossless_3d covers 2D images used by 3D materials.
tradeoff: The texture can pick up compression artifacts.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A layered texture import (cubemap, array or 3D texture) does not generate mipmaps
suggestion: Turn mipmaps/generate on for cubemaps, texture arrays and 3D textures shown at varying distances; sampling smaller versions is faster and needs less memory bandwidth. Plain 2D textures are not counted here (2D mipmaps only help when the camera zooms out); textures.no_mipmaps covers 2D images used by 3D materials.
tradeoff: UI textures that must stay sharp sometimes leave mipmaps off.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A texture import is VRAM-uncompressed
suggestion: compress/mode 3 is VRAM uncompressed. Switch 3D textures to VRAM compressed. The image import tutorial describes the modes.
tradeoff: Compressed textures can show block artifacts.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: VRAM-compressed textures use high-quality BPTC/ASTC compression
heuristic_rationale: The .import file does not record whether the image is opaque; for transparent images both modes use 8 bits per pixel, so only opaque textures lose memory.
evidence: When using S3TC, DXT1 (BC1) is used for opaque textures and DXT5 (BC3) is used for transparent or normal map (RGTC) textures.
suggestion: Turn compress/high_quality off for opaque textures where BC1 block artifacts are acceptable: BC7 (BPTC) stores 8 bits per pixel where DXT1 stores 4.
tradeoff: High quality avoids BC1 block artifacts and is required to VRAM-compress HDR images.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: HDR textures are imported without VRAM compression
evidence: Never use VRAM compression for HDR textures, regardless of whether they're opaque or transparent.
suggestion: Set compress/hdr_compression back to Opaque Only (or Always) and enable compress/high_quality so BPTC/ASTC can compress the .exr/.hdr image.
tradeoff: VRAM-compressed HDR loses some precision; keep Disabled where exact HDR values matter.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: A glTF import embeds its images uncompressed
evidence: textures compressed losslessly into the generated scene
suggestion: Set gltf/embedded_image_handling back to Extract Textures (the default) so the images can be VRAM-compressed, or to Embed as Basis Universal.
tradeoff: Extracted textures become separate files in the project.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: An OBJ import disables mesh LOD generation
evidence: generates lower detail variants of the mesh which will be displayed in the distance to improve rendering performance.
suggestion: Turn generate_lods back on for OBJ meshes that are rendered from a distance.
tradeoff: LODs add import time and file size; meshes always seen up close gain nothing.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: An OBJ import disables shadow mesh generation
evidence: This optimizes shadow rendering without reducing quality by welding vertices together when possible.
suggestion: Turn generate_shadow_mesh back on unless the mesh never casts shadows.
tradeoff: Shadow meshes add a little import time and memory.
expected_effect: scan_scene should show a lower count after the edit. No frame-time percentage is predicted.
